messages:
sam: Opening a quick PR to modernize the hello-quickstart: switch to ephemeral token examples, fix the broken auth link, and add a trivial Docker health check. Can someone glance?

ivy: Happy to skim. Which auth link is broken?

sam: The tutorial points at /docs/auth/session which returns 404. I'll update to /docs/auth/ephemeral-tokens and add a small stub page.

leo: For snippets, show both node and curl. Curl is handy for CI. Example I use: 
```bash
EPHEMERAL=$(curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/issue_token -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" -d '{"expires_in":300}' | jq -r '.token')
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $EPHEMERAL" http://localhost:8080/health
```

ivy: Also noticed Dockerfile EXPOSE 3000 but the app serves on 8080. Standardize on 8080 and add a /health endpoint snippet.

sam: Good catch. I'll change EXPOSE and add the health route. Also removing the outdated Console screenshot and replacing with a link to Console for now.

docs-bot: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/599 (draft). Reviewers: @ivy @leo

leo: Left two tiny nit comments in the PR: env var should be RW_API_KEY and prefer double quotes in curl data for portability.

build-bot: Canary build queued for PR #599 -> build-2026-03-22-21. Will post status when done.

ivy: LGTM after the nit fixes.

build-bot: Canary build succeeded for PR #599 6 min. Image pushed to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/hello-quickstart:pr-599

sam: Thanks all, undrafting and merging now. Follow-up: file a design ticket to update Console screenshots properly.
